product.name: Rent Guarantee
product.description: Provides financial protection for landlords in case of tenant defaults, covering up to 12 months' rent, legal support, and property damage protection.

product.name: Tenant Report
product.description: Offers comprehensive tenant screening including credit checks, background checks, social media scans, and employment verification to help landlords choose reliable tenants.

product.name: Rent Collection
product.description: Facilitates the collection of rent payments from tenants on behalf of landlords, ensuring timely and secure transactions.
